THEORY
The given HCl solution is standardized by titrating it against standard Na2C03 solution. Then this standardized HCl solution is taken to determine the strength of given NaOH solution.
Titration is the technique of determining the strength of unknown solution by reacting it with the standard solution by means of volume measurement normally in presence of third chemical substance.
End point of titration is the point of completion of reaction in titration which is shown by the colour change of third chemical substance i.e. indicator.
Indicator is the third chemical substance used in ti&ation which helps to predict the end point of titration by its colour change.
The following reactions completely take place at the equivalence point i.e. theoretical end point.
Na2C03 + 2HC1 2NaC1 + H20 + C02 HCl + NaOH NaCl + H20 The strength normality is converted into the other terms as per the following relations.
